jobs.title: Artificial Intelligence
jobs.description: Skip to main content ARTIFICIAL INTELLIGENCE Build AI for a connected world We’re driven to build incredible things that connect people in inspiring ways. Whether it be in AI Infrastructure, Generative AI, NLP, Computer Vision or other core areas of AI, our focus is to connect people in inspiring ways through collaborative, responsible AI innovation. View AI jobs Advancing personal superintelligence Join us in pushing the boundaries of AI through research, infrastructure and product innovation. Muse Spark Muse Spark is the first LLM from Meta, purpose-built for Meta products — small and fast by design, but capable enough to process complex questions in science, math and health. Learn more Meta AI Built on Muse Spark, Meta AI is your upgraded personal assistant that can help anyone, anywhere with the things that matter most to them — from quick answers to complex problems that need strong reasoning. Learn more Meta Ray-Ban Display and Meta Neural Band Our first AI glasses with a private in-lens display and on-wrist control, Meta Ray-Ban Display and Meta Neural Band represent a breakthrough in wearables — pioneering compact, on-device AI and universally accessible EMG technology. Learn more Muse Image With the first media generation models developed by Meta, Meta is building entirely new ways for you to bring your ideas to life and getting one step closer to personal superintelligence. Learn more Why work on AI at Meta? Explore our culture View our benefits When it comes to AI, Meta is all in. Here, you’ll work on exciting projects, including developing personal superintelligence that helps people achieve their goals. You'll also benefit from our world-class infrastructure, which delivers the greatest compute per AI researcher. Take your career in AI to bold new heights Our company-wide focus on AI fosters a culture of innovation, helping us drive progress and unlock new breakthroughs at incredible speed. Building AI that positively impacts society reinforces our commitment to transparency, and making leading investments in AI infrastructure lays the groundwork for future endeavors.
